purpose: Describe causing or allowing someone to perform an action.
keywords: Ichidan stem + させる; godan a-stem + せる; する → させる; 来る → 来させる.
The teacher had the students write an essay.
The mother let the child play in the park.
formation: Ichidan stem + させる; godan a-stem + せる; する → させる; 来る → 来させる.
restrictions: Context determines whether it means make or let.
mistake: Causative participants and particles depend on the base verb’s transitivity.
